title: Data Investigation
text:
For this project, we will be looking at CDC data about Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART). This data provides information about fertility clinics across the United States in the years 2020-2022. Links to download each year of the data are provided below:

2020 data
2021 data
2022 data



First, load in all libraries that are needed for this data investigation.

library(tidyverse)

✔ forcats   1.0.1     ✔ stringr   1.6.0
✔ ggplot2   4.0.3     ✔ tibble    3.3.1
✔ lubridate 1.9.5     ✔ tidyr     1.3.2
✔ purrr     1.2.2

✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter()
✖ dplyr::lag()    masks stats::lag()

library(dplyr)




Read in each year of data and stack together into one data set.

rawdata2020 <- read_csv("data/2020_Final_Assisted_Reproductive_Technology_(ART)_Services_and_Profiles_20261024.csv")
